property_summary: For any caller, AdjustDifficulty succeeds (does not revert) and updates difficulty to the given amount if and only if msg.sender == owner; the mutant rejects the owner and allows non-owners, so a call by the owner will revert on the mutant but succeed on the original.
change_summary: Change require(msg.sender == owner) to require(msg.sender != owner) so only non-owners can call AdjustDifficulty, changing who can update difficulty.
